question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. All numbers are single-digit numbers.Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) @ 8 $ & + 7 1 * 6 % Ω £ 2 4 5 9 # 3 (Right)

How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by another symbol?
solution:
Given: (Left) @ 8 $ & + 7 1 * 6 % Ω £ 2 4 5 9 # 3 (Right)

Now, 

Numbers which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by another symbol.

So, Needed pattern is: Symbol - Number - Symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2df3cf014720b1e53f09a3a80e1f0bef4ee287fb9a10f7d24e8f22f63685df2.png]
